text:
alex: Heads-up — our SAST/DAST pipelines started failing on the prod branch after the RBAC cleanup this morning. CI runner logs show KMS decrypt denied for artifact unpack. :frowning:
priya: Ugh. I saw alerts too. This only affects the prod pipeline; staging is green. Did anyone touch the scanner service account policy? :eyes:
sam: I pushed the RBAC change (narrowing scanner SA to staging-only) to stop noisy tests. I didn't think it would affect prod runners — likely scope leak. Will revert if needed.
infra-bot: alert: [ci-prod] job=scan-runner-42 status=FAILED reason="AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt" resource=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
mara: Can someone paste the exact error payload? Need the condition/arn to confirm whether it's a key policy or IAM condition.
alex: here's the snippet from the runner:
```
2026-03-22T09:12:15Z ERROR: KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
Message: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/ci-prod-runner is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
Context: Condition `aws:PrincipalTag/project` mismatch
```
priya: That Condition bit is interesting — the key policy requires a principal tag `project:redwood-prod`. The scanner SA didn't have that tag after the RBAC update.
tia: Also: audit logs for today show the RBAC change (sam) but I don't see any admin approval entries or ephemeral grant entries for the quickfix attempts. We may have an audit gap for manual overrides.
sam: I tried a temp workaround: added the tag back, triggered a test scan — it passed. But I don't want to leave that ad-hoc patch. We need a proper incident/action.
mara: Agreed. Proposed short plan:
- rollback the RBAC narrowing for scanner SA (short-term revert) — sam
- create ephemeral-role flow for prod scanner with required tags — infra
- update keystore key policy to enumerate the scanner role instead of relying on tags (or at least log the tag-assertion) — security
- add an audit hook that records any manual tag additions to the scanner SA and who triggered them — tia
alex: Can we also add a CI preflight that validates KMS key principal conditions vs runner tags? Failing fast would prevent this class of outage.
priya: Yes, I'll sketch a GH action that compares key policy expectations to active SA tags before starting heavy scans.
sam: I'll do the rollback now and open PR for ephemeral-role automation.
tia: I'll open the incident ticket (SECU-2026) and paste this thread + timeline. Please add short notes when you make changes so audit can track it.
infra-bot: action: created incident SECU-2026, assignees=[priya, sam, tia]
mara: After rollback, I'll re-run the last 3 prod scans and then verify CloudTrail shows the temporary grant events. If CloudTrail doesn't, we need to escalate to SRE for deeper logging.
alex: Thanks. After this, let's add test coverage for both tag-based and role-based key access. Also add a short doc fragment to the secure-sdlc runbook about key policy changes.
priya: noted — I'll PR the runbook entry and GH action.
sam: rollback done (reverted commit abc123). prod run triggered, keeping an eye.
mara: prod scans back to green. CloudTrail shows the revert, but I don't see explicit manual-tag events — looks like tagging happens via the CI assume-role flow, not via console. We should instrument that flow.
tia: Filing an audit improvement item in SECU-2026: 'instrument CI assume-role tag emission and add audit hook' — assigning to infra.
alex: Good work team. Postmortem template: timeline, root cause (RBAC narrow + tag reliance), remediation (ephemeral role + policy hardening + CI preflight), and follow-ups (audit hook, runbook entry). :thumbsup:
priya: I'll consolidate notes and send for review in ~30m.
__notes: Generated thread about RBAC change causing KMS decrypt failures in prod SAST/DAST pipeline, with triage and incident actions. No title field per agents.md rules.
